intervention_scopes: Change physical time units and contrast a density mismatch with equality; rate, mean and information transform in different units.
Change binary group success fractions and verify coefficient, probability and covariance responses from the original likelihood.
Move a binary sample to complete separation and constrain a path: existence at a boundary differs from an interior zero-score solution.
Replace an estimated covariate distribution with a known fixed target; remove only its empirical-distribution influence, while retaining coefficient uncertainty.
Misspecify conditional binary probabilities while retaining a centered unconditional score; a nonzero cross covariance changes the average-effect variance.
Preserve the conditional count means but change within-group dispersion; the coefficients remain targeted while their robust covariance changes.
Double every count: fitted log intercept shifts, robust log-parameter variance stays invariant, but the Poisson-model variance changes.
Omit the group regressor: a centered unconditional score and a sandwich do not recover the missing conditional mean contrast.
Reverse selection correlation and shift the selection cutoff; direct Gaussian-density integrals preserve the mixed probability budget and change selected moments.
Switch selected-only to joint observed sampling with selection counts; the normalization and information about the selection index differ.
Change the uniform endpoint scale and sample size while retaining the exact maximum distribution; finite and limiting confidence calculations remain distinct.
Compare support-dependent likelihoods with ordinary interior score logic: the missing moving-boundary derivative is nonzero.
